children: Factrika raises Rs 8.9 crore seed funding led by Info Edge to expand its industrial workforce platform and strengthen technology and team capabilities
Factrika, an on-demand industrial workforce platform, has raised Rs 8.9 crore in a seed funding round led by Info Edge
Founded in July 2024 by Kshitij Puri and Gaurav Asthana, the company will use the funding to expand its team, develop its technology and increase its presence across industrial clusters in India

Factrika connects manufacturers with verified workers based on skills and availability, with the platform enabling worker deployment within two hours. Workers can accept shifts digitally, while the platform manages attendance and payments and maintains a digital record of their work history

The company said Indian factories face a daily worker shortage of 20–25 per cent, which it attributes to fragmented contractor-based staffing models. Factrika aims to address this gap by providing manufacturers with access to workers based on their skills and availability

Factrika currently has more than 10,000 registered workers across more than 20 skill categories. The company said its worker show rate is above 90 per cent, while deployment hours have been growing by 50–70 per cent month on month
Its clients include Lenskart, Munjal Kiriu, Asahi India Glass, Jubilant Foods, Epack Durables, PG Technoplast, Hanon Climate, Bidso and Talbros Auto Components

The company said workers using its platform can increase their earnings by 20–30 per cent through skill progression. The latest funding will also support expansion across industrial clusters, with Bhiwadi, Manesar, Bawal, Noida and Bahadurgarh among the locations identified for expansion
Factrika is targeting India's manufacturing workforce market, which it estimates at USD 23 billion

Factrika is focused on making industrial workforce availability more responsive to manufacturers’ requirements, with worker matching based on skills and availability, said Kshitij Puri and Gaurav Asthana, Founders of Factrika

Hitesh Oberoi, MD and CEO of Info Edge India, said Factrika is addressing recruitment and workforce availability requirements in the manufacturing sector through a platform-based model, and we have invested in the company as part of its seed funding round

Puri is a second-time founder who previously built ZipLoan, a fintech NBFC. He is an alumnus of UCLA Anderson and ICAI. Asthana is an alumnus of BITS Pilani and IIM Ahmedabad and has more than two decades of experience across technology, operations and product roles in recruitment, fintech, agritech and marketplaces
